name: New Amsterdam Invest N.V.
summary: New Amsterdam Invest N.V., through its subsidiary, Somerset Park B.V., operates as a commercial real estate company in the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, and the United States of America. The company leases investment property under operating leases. It also owns and manages real estate properties. New Amsterdam Invest N.V. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
